verdict.rationale: Gitea docs mention user permission management and access control lists (gitea-docs-7) and collaborator/repository management (gitea-docs-1), implying repo-level and branch-level protections exist, but there is no explicit evidence of workspace/organization-level or fine-grained branch-level permission controls, nor any hands-on confirmation of granularity across all four levels. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of organization/team permission scoping, branch protection rules, and independent/hands-on verification of granular access control across workspace, project, repo, and branch levels.
